research_only_setups.trigger: After 09:45 ET and a reset $149-$151 holding $147.40, completed 5-min close >153.30 and above RTH VWAP and actual OR15 high; spread<=0.25%, volume >=1.5x prior 5-bar median, SOXX breadth positive
research_only_setups.skip: Any support failure, spread >0.25%, no volume confirmation, OR15 high beyond reference trigger, deteriorating sector breadth, stale buying power, or permissions disabled

under5.best_verified_catalyst: RCAT bearish earnings/guidance withdrawal; AYTU cash acquisition $2.70; GP small-float earnings spike
under5.AYTU: STRUCTURAL_REJECT momentum capped by $2.70 cash acquisition and completion risk
under5.RCAT: REJECT_CURRENT_ENTRY + KEEP_ACTIVE_WATCH spread 1.25%, deep down-gap, corporate risk
